opinions.text: App. Ct. Ill., 5th Dist. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 808.] Motion of Daniel M. Kirwan to vacate order of Court entered October 30, 1989 [ante, p. 930], and to appoint substitute counsel granted, and it is ordered that Dan W. Evers, Esq., of Mount Vernon, Ill., be appointed to serve as counsel for respondent in this case.
